notes:
MUJI Japan, fetched via curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124 (SSR HTML). Checked full desktop/mobile nav and homepage pickup panels; found two candidates. (1) /jp/ja/store/cmdty/section/T10022 'もったいない市' ("Mottainai Ichi"/"No-Waste Market") - a top-level nav item alongside SALE/新商品. Its own meta description reads (translated): 'Out of a wish not to let things go to waste, this initiative sells products returned due to scratches/stains - still fully usable - as used or like-new items at bargain prices.' This is a genuine, permanent, site-defined outlet/return-goods clearance concept (not a seasonal promo), so it qualifies as Clearance. Verified as a real PLP: SSR pager reads '57件中 1件〜40件表示' (57 total, showing 1-40) and page 1 has exactly 40 unique product-detail links, confirming a live, paginated listing. (2) /jp/ja/store/cmdty/section/X00001 'SALE' - a top-level nav item, 679 items (pager '679件中 1件〜40件表示'). Its meta description reads (translated): 'Here you can view MUJI's SALE information... items across fashion, furniture, storage, curtains, interior goods, etc. at sale prices' - a generic, blended promotional-sale listing with NO permanence/outlet language at the page level, matching the brief's 'generic temporary promotional sale - do NOT include' guidance, so it is EXCLUDED as Clearance. Note: X00001's embedded filter facet list (priceType) does include an 'アウトレット' (Outlet) tag alongside 'SALE', 'いっしょ割', 'よりどり', '期間限定価格', 'まとめ買い', suggesting some SALE items are individually outlet-tagged, but there is no distinct site-exposed URL/count for an Outlet-only subset (attempted a ?priceType=アウトレット query param, which had no effect on the SSR result - the facet is client-side/GraphQL driven, not URL-addressable at tier-1) - since MUJI does not expose this as its own PLP the way もったいない市 is exposed, it is not recorded as a separate row rather than guessing an unverifiable subset qty. Did not find セール used to mean anything beyond this generic SALE page; no 在庫処分 or わけあり pages/text found anywhere in nav or homepage state.
